{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit with sharp shoulders, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy-weight fabric for wind resistance.
Tapered trousers, straight leg cut, medium length to show a hint of ankle, stone beige (#F5F5DC), stretch twill material that resists water.
An oversized silk-blend scarf, loose drape around the neck, deep burgundy (#800020), lightweight but warm fabric.
Leather ankle boots, shaft just above the calf, heel height of 6cm for elegance and stability in wet conditions, dark brown (#3B241A), waterproof nubuck leather.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an evening out in rainy, windy autumn weather by combining a structured outer layer with water-resistant materials that protect against the elements while remaining warm. The neutral tones of the jacket and trousers create a polished, sophisticated silhouette suitable for a date night at the cinema followed by a fine dinner, while the rich burgundy scarf adds a necessary pop of color to cut through the cool grey atmosphere. Finally, the choice of ankle boots with a sturdy heel ensures comfort and safety on slick surfaces without sacrificing the refined style expected for an evening event."}
